title: SentinelAntiCheat
description: Lightweight movement checks with staff alerts.
body:
# SentinelAntiCheat

Lightweight movement checks with staff alerts.

## Features
- Speed and fly checks with configurable thresholds.
- Violation tracking with alert cooldown.
- Optional auto-kick on repeated violations.
- Bypass permission for staff and special players.

## Command
- `/sentinelac status | reset <player> | reload`

## Permissions
- `sentinelac.alert`
- `sentinelac.admin`
- `sentinelac.bypass`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
max-horizontal-bps: 7.0
violations-before-alert: 4
kick-enabled: false
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
